tagline: Protecting against peak perils and building resilience
hero_kpi_rationale: Key profitability indicator for a reinsurance company, reflecting overall performance after claims, reserves, and investment management. ROE of 15% exceeds multi-year strategic target.

kpis.name: Group net income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all charges, claims, and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reached 3.2 billion dollars in 2024, up from 3.1 billion in 2023.
kpis.signal: High ROE at 15%, above multi-year strategic target of 14%.

kpis.name: Insurance and reinsurance revenue
kpis.explanation: Premiums collected by all insurance and reinsurance business units.
kpis.description: Insurance revenue reached 45.6 billion dollars in 2024, versus 43.9 billion in 2023.
kpis.signal: Sustained premium growth on back of elevated demand.

kpis.name: Investment return
kpis.explanation: Annual performance of financial assets held by Swiss Re.
kpis.description: Investment return increased from 3.2% in 2023 to 4.0% in 2024, driven by higher recurring income and reinvestment yield of 4.6% in Q4.
kpis.signal: Marked improvement in investment portfolio returns.

kpis.name: SST solvency ratio
kpis.explanation: Financial strength indicator required by FINMA in Switzerland.
kpis.description: SST ratio stood at 257% as of January 1, 2025, above the target range of 200-250%.
kpis.signal: Equity capital well above the target range to cover risks.

kpis.name: P&C Reinsurance combined ratio
kpis.explanation: Technical profitability indicator: claims cost plus expenses divided by premiums.
kpis.description: P&C Re combined ratio stood at 89.9% in 2024, versus 87.0% in 2023, due to decisive reserve adjustments of 2.6 billion USD over the full year.
kpis.signal: Deterioration linked to reserve strengthening in Q3 2024.

kpis.name: Corporate Solutions net income
kpis.explanation: Profitability of Swiss Re's commercial insurance segment.
kpis.description: Corporate Solutions profit reached 829 million dollars in 2024, versus 658 million in 2023, driven by disciplined underwriting and rigorous portfolio management.
kpis.signal: Exceptional performance with 26% growth and combined ratio of 89.7% below the 93% target.

kpis.name: Life and Health Reinsurance net income
kpis.explanation: Profit of the life and health reinsurance segment.
kpis.description: L&H Re profit stood at 1.5 billion dollars in 2024, versus 1.4 billion in 2023, reflecting healthy portfolio margins and solid investment income.
kpis.signal: Achievement of annual target with sustained margins and solid investment experience.

kpis.name: Total assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 134.01 billion euros in the latest year

risks.title: Intensification of natural catastrophes
risks.score_rationale: Central position in 10-K, strong language (turbulent, tragic wildfires), upward trend in losses, critical category for P&C Re business.

risks.title: Increased competition in digital solutions
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of iptiQ withdrawal, strategic language on refocusing, market consolidation trend, innovation-related risk.

risks.title: Dependence on internal risk models
risks.score_rationale: Reference to 50 scientists and 200 internal models, strong technical language, investment trend, central risk for underwriting.

risks.title: Growing regulatory pressure on climate transition
risks.score_rationale: Mandatory publication of Climate Transition Plan, FINMA mention, rising requirements trend, high weight in Switzerland.

risks.title: Dependence on direct client relationships
risks.score_rationale: Emphasis on sustainable relationships, language valuing client franchise, reinforcement trend, major strategic risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of sensitive client data
risks.score_rationale: Access to critical data via clients, implicit mention through digital services, rising cyberattack trend, high operational risk.

risks.title: Talent management in a tight market
risks.score_rationale: Mention of aging and scarcity of talent, proactive language on development, stable trend, moderate weight.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or its applications in the 2024 annual report. Swiss Re does not position AI as a strategic lever in its recent communications.
evidence: No reference to AI in the shareholder letter
Absence of AI-related initiatives or KPIs in business segments
No mention of AI tools in claims management, underwriting, or investments
